**02**

# Executive Build Brief

| **Decision**      | **V1 requirement**                                                                                |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Platform          | WordPress on managed hosting. No custom application framework.                                    |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Primary role      | Owned canonical publishing library for Human Signals.                                             |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Newsletter        | Substack remains the email/subscriber engine.                                                     |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Distribution      | LinkedIn and Medium distribute/adapt content; they are not the canonical archive.                 |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Content at launch | 6–8 flagship essays, 2 reports, About, Subscribe. Remaining content held as scheduled inventory.  |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Design            | Editorial, whitespace-led, minimal UI, strong typography, restrained photography/illustration.    |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Owner control     | Alok must be able to publish/edit an essay or report in under 5 minutes.                          |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |
| Scope guardrail   | No membership system, community, app, dashboards, paid-course engine or bespoke automation in V1. |
| ---               | ---                                                                                               |

_Success is not a "beautiful homepage". Success is a fast, trustworthy publication in which content is easy to discover, pleasant to read and simple to maintain._

## Recommended technology stack

- Managed WordPress hosting with SSL, backups, staging and server-side caching.
- Lightweight Gutenberg/block-based theme or similarly maintainable editorial theme. Avoid heavy page builders unless absolutely necessary.
- Native WordPress Posts for Essays; Custom Post Types (or equivalent structured content) for Reports and Guides.
- Substack standard subscribe embed or supported link flow. Do not build unsupported custom subscription integrations.
- GA4 + Google Search Console; basic privacy-friendly cookie configuration as required.
- Image optimisation to WebP/AVIF where supported; lazy loading below the fold.

**04**

# Homepage Specification

## Section 1 — Header

- Left: Human Signals wordmark. Small strapline may sit beneath on desktop only.
- Navigation: Home, Essays, Reports, Guides, About. Subscribe as a visually distinct button.
- Optional search icon. Search must work across Essays, Reports and Guides.
- Sticky header acceptable only if compact and unobtrusive on mobile.

## Section 2 — Hero

- H1: Human Signals or a strong editorial lead line; avoid rotating sliders/carousels.
- Tagline: "Psychology, behaviour and the choices we make."
- Support copy: "Ideas, essays and research by Alok Jha on why people think, choose and behave the way they do."
- Primary CTA: Explore Essays. Secondary CTA: Subscribe Free / Get the Free Reports.
- One calm editorial image maximum. No generic "brain/neuron" stock imagery.

## Section 3 — Explore Human Signals

- Five category cards: Mind, Choice, Money, Business, AI + Human.
- Each card: title + one-line explanation + subtle image or typographic treatment.

## Section 4 — Featured Essays

- Display 4–6 essays, selected manually by editor rather than automatically "latest only".
- Card: category, reading time, title, 1–2 line deck, image, Read more.

## Section 5 — Human Signals Reports

- Feature Founding Series: The Choice Trap; The Indian Buyer; When Humans Trust Machines; After the Role Changes; The Founder Mind Under Pressure.
- Each report card: number, title, subtitle/description, "Download Free" CTA.

## Section 6 — Subscribe

- Headline: "Join Human Signals."
- Support copy: "One thoughtful exploration of human behaviour each week. Free."
- Use Substack supported embed/link. Keep the form visually native to Human Signals.

## Section 7 — About + Footer

- Short 80–120 word author note with professional photograph.
- Footer: navigation, copyright, Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer, social links.

## Essay page visual hierarchy

1. Category eyebrow
2. Headline
3. Deck
4. Author + date + optional reading time
5. Featured visual (optional)
6. Article body
7. Reader question / pull quote
8. Sources / further reading if used
9. Related essays
10. Subscribe CTA

_Article pages should feel almost distraction-free. No persistent sidebars, flashing related-content widgets, ad slots or aggressive popups in V1._

## Recommended V1 flow

1. Reader lands on report page from website, LinkedIn, Medium or Substack.
2. Page explains the report before asking for anything.
3. Invite reader to subscribe to Human Signals through the supported Substack form/link.
4. Provide a clear direct Download Free link/button on the same page.
5. Do not build custom email-to-download automation unless there is a fully supported, maintainable integration.

_Use a soft gate, not technical friction. The first five reports are acquisition and credibility assets; the experience should feel generous._

**08**

# CMS & Content Model

## Content types

| **Content type** | **Recommended implementation** | **Key reason**                                                   |
| ---------------- | ------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Essays           | Native WordPress Posts         | Best fit for categories, archive, RSS and publishing workflow.   |
| ---              | ---                            | ---                                                              |
| Reports          | Custom Post Type: Reports      | Separate fields, numbering, downloads and future pricing states. |
| ---              | ---                            | ---                                                              |
| Guides           | Custom Post Type: Guides       | Separate downloadable product/library experience.                |
| ---              | ---                            | ---                                                              |
| Pages            | Native Pages                   | Home, About, Subscribe, Privacy, Terms, Disclaimer.              |
| ---              | ---                            | ---                                                              |

## Editorial controls

- Manual Featured flag for homepage selection.
- Draft / Scheduled / Published status available to owner.
- Preview before publication.
- Revisions enabled.
- No public comments in V1 unless explicitly switched on later.
- Default author is Alok Jha; support additional authors later without redesign.

## Permalinks

- Essays: /essays/{slug}/ OR /{category}/{slug}/ — developer to select one stable convention and never change casually.
- Reports: /reports/{slug}/
- Guides: /guides/{slug}/
- Avoid dates in URLs. Avoid query-string URLs for public content.

**09**

# Owner Publishing Workflow

| **Action**              | **Target time** | **Steps**                                                                              |
| ----------------------- | --------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Publish essay           | ≤5 minutes      | Add New → Title → Category → Paste/format → image/alt → preview → publish/schedule.    |
| ---                     | ---             | ---                                                                                    |
| Publish report          | ≤7 minutes      | Add Report → fill structured fields → upload PDF → preview → publish.                  |
| ---                     | ---             | ---                                                                                    |
| Update featured content | ≤2 minutes      | Toggle Featured or choose via homepage editor module.                                  |
| ---                     | ---             | ---                                                                                    |
| Edit existing content   | ≤3 minutes      | Open → revise → update. URL should remain unchanged unless deliberate redirect exists. |
| ---                     | ---             | ---                                                                                    |

## Formatting rules for imported Word content

- Paste as plain/rich text into Gutenberg; remove Word-specific formatting cruft.
- Use paragraph blocks, H2/H3, pull quote, simple list and image blocks only.
- Never manually set fonts, colours or arbitrary sizes inside individual articles.
- Avoid tables on mobile unless data genuinely requires them.
- Check quotation marks, em dashes, ₹ symbol and italic/bold after paste.

**10**

# Substack, Medium & LinkedIn Integration

## Substack

- Role: subscriber database, weekly email newsletter and platform discovery.
- Embed or link standard Substack subscribe flow from HumanSignals.in.
- Website article remains canonical/original. Substack email can carry an intro/excerpt + link to full essay.
- Do not connect HumanSignals.in as a Substack custom domain in this architecture.

## Medium

- Role: discovery and incremental readership.
- Republish/import selected articles only after website publication.
- Ensure canonical attribution points to the HumanSignals.in original when using Medium import/canonical tools.

## LinkedIn

- Role: professional distribution and author-led reach.
- Use the existing Human Signals LinkedIn short-essay library; do not auto-cross-post full web articles.
- Links to website/report should be contextual rather than appended to every post mechanically.

# SEO & Discoverability Requirements

| **Requirement**   | **Acceptance standard**                                                        |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Titles            | Unique descriptive page title for every essay/report/page.                     |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Meta descriptions | Editable; auto fallback only if editor leaves blank.                           |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Canonical         | Self-referencing canonical on HumanSignals.in originals.                       |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Sitemap           | XML sitemap includes Essays, Reports, Guides and core Pages.                   |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Robots            | No accidental noindex on public production pages.                              |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Schema            | Article/BlogPosting for essays; Person for Alok; Breadcrumb where appropriate. |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Open Graph        | Title, description and social share image generated per item.                  |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Internal linking  | Related essays plus contextual internal links inside articles.                 |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| 404 / redirects   | Custom 404; safe 301 redirect capability if URLs change.                       |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |
| Search            | Functional site search with useful zero-result handling.                       |
| ---               | ---                                                                            |

## Editorial SEO principle

_Do not turn Human Signals into an SEO-content factory. Search optimisation should make good essays discoverable, not dictate generic topics or awkward keyword repetition._

**12**

# Performance, Accessibility & Security

| **Area**      | **V1 requirement**                                                                                               |
| ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Mobile        | Design and QA mobile-first. Typography, cards, downloads and forms must work at 360–430px widths.                |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |
| Performance   | Compressed responsive images, lazy loading, minimal third-party scripts, caching and CDN if hosting provides it. |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |
| Accessibility | Semantic headings, keyboard navigation, visible focus states, alt text, colour contrast, labelled forms.         |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |
| Backups       | Automatic daily or frequent backups plus one-click restore.                                                      |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |
| Updates       | Core/plugin/theme update policy defined. Avoid plugin sprawl.                                                    |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |
| Security      | SSL, strong admin password, 2FA where available, limit admin accounts, anti-spam on forms.                       |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |
| Privacy       | Privacy page; explain newsletter/data collection. Do not collect unnecessary personal data.                      |
| ---           | ---                                                                                                              |

# Launch Content Configuration

## Six flagship essays to publish at launch

- Who Are You When Your Job Title Disappears?
- Why We Know What to Do — and Still Don't Do It
- Why Intelligent People Make Irrational Decisions
- Why People With Enough Money Still Feel Financially Insecure
- Why ₹999 Feels Different From ₹1,000
- When Personalisation Stops Feeling Helpful and Starts Feeling Creepy

## Reports at launch

- The Choice Trap — free.
- The Indian Buyer — free.
- Reports 03–05 loaded into CMS but can be released sequentially over the following weeks.

## Do not publish all 50 essays at once

- Load/schedule the inventory internally if useful.
- Public launch should feel curated, not like a database dump.
- Publish one flagship essay per week thereafter.

**15**

# Developer QA & Acceptance Checklist

- ☐ Homepage matches approved editorial direction and works on desktop/tablet/mobile.
- ☐ No horizontal scrolling at common mobile widths.
- ☐ All top navigation links work; active states are clear.
- ☐ Essay categories display correctly and archive pagination works.
- ☐ Site search returns Essays, Reports and Guides.
- ☐ Essay template has correct H1 hierarchy and readable typography.
- ☐ Report PDF download works on desktop and mobile.
- ☐ Substack subscribe form/link works and failure states are understandable.
- ☐ Featured essay/report selection can be changed by owner without code.
- ☐ Images have alt text field and responsive sizing.
- ☐ GA4, Search Console and download/CTA events are configured.
- ☐ XML sitemap accessible; canonical tags correct; production pages indexable.
- ☐ 404 page exists; redirects can be created if needed.
- ☐ Privacy, Terms and Disclaimer linked in footer.
- ☐ Admin has strong security and backup/restore confirmed.
- ☐ Alok receives a 30–45 minute handover showing how to publish an Essay, Report and Guide.
- ☐ Developer provides a one-page admin cheat sheet after handover.

**16**

# Explicitly Out of Scope for V1

- Paid membership / paywall
- Online courses or LMS
- Community/forum
- Mobile app
- User accounts and dashboards
- Complex CRM
- Custom AI chatbot
- Advanced recommendation engine
- Advertising stack
- Podcast/video platform
- Custom Substack API workarounds
- Multiple author workflow beyond basic future support
- E-commerce beyond "coming soon" placeholders

_If a feature does not help readers discover, read, subscribe to or download Human Signals content, it probably does not belong in Version 1._

**19**

# Final Sign-off Standard

**Human Signals V1 is ready to launch when:**

- A first-time visitor can understand what Human Signals is within 10 seconds.
- A reader can reach a relevant essay in no more than two clicks from Home.
- An essay is pleasant to read on a phone for 5–10 minutes.
- A report can be understood and downloaded without confusion.
- A visitor can subscribe without navigating away unnecessarily.
- Alok can publish new content himself without developer assistance.
- The site feels like a thoughtful independent publication — not a corporate consultancy or generic psychology portal.

**HUMAN SIGNALS**

_Psychology, behaviour and the choices we make._
